errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the sector "Електрическа енергия" (Electrical energy) has the smallest share with 1.6%. According to the chart, the sector with the smallest share is "Възобн. и биогорива" (Renewable and biofuels) with 1.2%.
The description expands the abbreviated label from the legend. The legend shows "Възобн. и биогорива", while the description writes out the full word "Възобновяеми и биогорива".
